spec.revision: Falcon Specification v1.2 (01/10/2020); PDF cover is the 2020-10-01 revision despite the file name

source.build_model: one shared reference build (falcon.c + codec/common/fft/fpr/keygen/rng/shake/sign/vrfy); the signature format is selected at runtime through FALCON_SIG_COMPRESSED | FALCON_SIG_PADDED | FALCON_SIG_CT

api.verify: falcon_verify(sig, sig_len, sig_type, pk, pk_len, msg, msg_len, tmp, tmp_len)
api.sign_seeded: shake256_init+inject(seed)+flip -> falcon_sign_dyn (nonce and sampler both drawn from SHAKE256(seed))
api.signed_message_sign: detached compressed signature re-framed as BE16(1+len(comp)) || salt[40] || message || 0x29/0x2A || comp (spec section 3.11.6)
api.signed_message_open: parse the frame, extract salt/message/comp and call falcon_verify with FALCON_SIG_COMPRESSED

hash.function: SHAKE256 (FIPS 202) inside the official reference shake.c
hash.hash_to_point: hash_to_point_vartime for COMPRESSED/PADDED, hash_to_point_ct for CT; both consume big-endian 16-bit samples, keep t < 5*q = 61445 and output t mod q until n coefficients are produced
hash.domain_separation: none beyond the 40-byte salt prefix; the salt is hashed first, then the message

signature_layout.compressed: 0x39/0x3A || salt[40] || compressed s2 bitstream (variable length, capacity from the API contract)
signature_layout.padded: 0x39/0x3A || salt[40] || compressed s2 || zero padding to exactly 666/1280 bytes; partial padding is invalid
signature_layout.ct: 0x59/0x5A || salt[40] || n 12-bit signed s2 coefficients, -2048 forbidden; exact length 809/1577
signature_layout.accepted_formats_by_profile: adapter verifies with the profile sig_type; sig_type=0 header inference is deliberately not used as the adapter contract
signature_layout.sig_max_len_semantics: capacity from the target API FALCON_SIG_COMPRESSED_MAXSIZE/FALCON_SIG_PADDED_SIZE/FALCON_SIG_CT_SIZE; not an exact length
signature_layout.compressed_coefficient_limit: the pinned reference comp_decode rejects |s2_i| > 2047; recorded as an implementation limit rather than a PDF mathematical rule

build_flags: default config.h: FALCON_FPNATIVE (IEEE-754 binary64), no FALCON_AVX2/FALCON_FMA, little-endian x86-64

kat_fixture.source: falcon-round3.zip KAT/falcon512-KAT.rsp and KAT/falcon1024-KAT.rsp (first records, generated 2020-10-06)
